counterfactual_missing_items: without spontaneous or inducible bleeding or discharge
decisive_items: well‐circumscribed, oval, covered by regular skin, firm, gray‐white
response.rationale: R2 is the only candidate that combines the polypoid, firm/fibrotic, well-circumscribed, gray-white, and encapsulated features. R3 shares the fibrotic and gross descriptors but lacks the polypoid and encapsulated features; R4 lacks the key firm/fibrotic consistency; R1 is contradicted by the firm/fibrotic consistency and the absence of bleeding/discharge.

rejected.why: Hemangioma is contradicted by the firm/fibrotic consistency and by the absence of spontaneous or inducible bleeding/discharge.
Neurofibroma is less supported because the key firm/fibrotic consistency is absent and no other neurofibromatosis stigmata are present.
